subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: leveling up
fact: The party has leveled up after surviving the Underdark’s trials.
source_quote: Alright, so the first thing is that we're all leveled up.

subject: Pudding King
fact: The Pudding King was pulled from its lair by sheer tactical geometry.
source_quote: I'd watched him pull the Pudding King out of its lair by sheer force of tactical geometry.

subject: Underdark terrain
fact: The Underdark is tight and low, making ranged combat critical.
source_quote: The Underdark is tight and low. But we're almost out. And this is a dangerous world...

subject: Dawnbringer blade
fact: Dawnbringer deals Radiant damage, not slashing, and burns with divine light.
source_quote: So question, so Dawnbringer is not slashing, right? It's actually… Radiant damage.

subject: Zhentarim Tactics adoption
fact: The character is considering adopting Zhentarim Tactics as a new fighting philosophy.
source_quote: Zhentarim Tactics.

subject: Fey Touched feat selection
fact: Daz chooses Fey Touched to gain additional prepared spells and free castings.
source_quote: Fey Touched. That was the one.

subject: Telekinetic feat utility
fact: Telekinetic is valued as a spatial geometry tool for repositioning allies.
source_quote: Telekinetic... moving Zalthir five feet in the right direction is more valuable than a Scorching Ray.

subject: Warcaster feat utility
fact: Warcaster is selected to improve concentration durability for sustained spells.
source_quote: Warcaster was the obvious answer... not decorative. It is the difference between the spell persisting and dissolving.

subject: Misty Step free casting
fact: Free Misty Step is prioritized for escaping grapples without provoking attacks of opportunity.
source_quote: No — being able to cast it without expending a spell slot is extremely useful. Because if you're in combat, it allows you to get out without incurring attacks of opportunity.

subject: Sculpt Spells synergy
fact: Sculpt Spells enables precise control over area effects like Cloud of Daggers to protect allies.
source_quote: Because I have my ability to shape spells... Sculpt Spells lets me carve exclusions into area effects.

subject: Grapple + Cloud of Daggers synergy
fact: Grapple locks enemies in place for Cloud of Daggers to persistently damage them.
source_quote: If you hold one in place, the daggers keep finding them.

subject: Rope binding action economy
fact: Binding a grappled enemy with rope consumes a full action but enables sustained control.
source_quote: Rope is slower. Tying something takes focus, takes both hands, takes the better part of a turn...

subject: Street Justice feat utility
fact: Street Justice allows Daz to bind grappled enemies with rope as a mechanical extension of his grappling.
source_quote: I found the Street Justice feat on his behalf — the one that let him use rope to bind enemies he'd already grappled.

subject: Monastery battlefield geometry
fact: The monastery taught battlefield geometry, though the specific lesson is forgotten.
source_quote: There was a class on this. At the monastery. Something about battlefield geometry and the difference between control and proximity.

subject: Ebonmire spellbook
fact: The Ebonmire spellbook is a key resource enabling expanded prepared spell selection.
source_quote: The spellbook we'd taken from Princess Ebonmire had been sitting in my pack like a promissory note I hadn't finished reading.

subject: Long arrangement philosophy
fact: The 'long arrangement' — positioning and preparation — is recognized as the true core of combat.
source_quote: Milo Goodbarrel had a chapter about this. He called it 'the long arrangement'...

subject: Darkness vs Fire spell conflict
fact: Darkness and fire spells historically interfere, but new tactics allow coexistence.
source_quote: The Darkness spell has always been the problem between Daz and me.

subject: Tactical synergy between Daz and Zalthir
fact: Daz's fire and Zalthir's grapple form a synergistic control combo in tight spaces.
source_quote: Daz could put his cloud directly on the grappled target and I would walk away without a scratch.

subject: Action economy prioritization
fact: A full turn is spent on grapple + bind to lock down one enemy for sustained damage.
source_quote: The whole turn — both pieces of it — spent on one enemy, pinned to the floor...

subject: Potion hoarding habit
fact: The character admits to a bad habit of hoarding potions instead of using them.
source_quote: I'm always like, oh, I don't know, I'm gonna save this potion for later, I might need it.

subject: Giant strength potion strategy
fact: The character considers using a potion of giant strength opportunistically rather than investing in permanent increases.
source_quote: Skip the investment, drink the potion of giant strength when it matters.

subject: Dark transition acceptance
fact: The character accepts a dark transformation from idealistic kid to pragmatic survivor.
source_quote: The happy-go-lucky kid... has spent months watching demon lords and eating mushrooms...

subject: Character evolution toward Zhentarim alignment
fact: The character is willing to adapt their story to reflect a morally ambiguous, effective fighting style.
source_quote: Well, I mean, I can work it into my story. It would be honest, even.

subject: Tactical geometry mastery
fact: Combat success is increasingly defined by spatial positioning and control rather than raw damage.
source_quote: Battles are often decided by who is standing where.
